summary_1line: Shiva grants Arjuna the devastating Pasupata weapon and other gods gather to witness his ascetic triumph and divine favor.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shiva touches Arjuna and reveals the terrible Pasupata weapon while the earth trembles and storms whirl around them.
The embodied Pasupata weapon stands beside Arjuna as gods and demons look on from the sky in awe.
Indra rides the white elephant Airavata beneath a white umbrella as other gods assemble around the meditating Arjuna on the mountain.
